adds.rationale: Intuitive Surgical's Q4-2024 print (Jan 23 2025, in-window) showed accelerating surgical-robotics traction — 493 da Vinci systems placed vs 415 a year earlier and ~18% procedure growth, with 2025 guidance of 13-16% — filling the watchlist's empty robotics slot with a de-risked, high-liquidity name rather than a speculative humanoid bet.

news_evidence.summary: Intuitive Surgical Q4/FY2024: worldwide da Vinci procedures grew ~18% YoY in Q4; 493 systems placed vs 415 in Q4 2023
Preliminary FY2024 at J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference: full-year procedures grew ~17%; guided to 13-16% procedure growth for 2025

rationale_overall: A single low-drama fill of the open robotics slot (9/10 -> 10/10) with Intuitive Surgical, whose Q4-2024 print showed real procedure-volume and system-placement acceleration — a buildup signal, not hype. No removes: the DeepSeek late-January AI selloff hit NVDA/MSFT/GOOGL prices but breached no thesis (no lost contracts, no regulatory blocks), so mean-variance can absorb the volatility without a curator override; RKLB, IONQ, ITA, FRO, WELL, CEG all show continuing (not deteriorating) thesis support. Thematic shape: AI (MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA), rockets (RKLB), quantum (IONQ), robotics (ISRG new), geopolitical (ITA, FRO), demographics (WELL), nuclear (CEG) — no bucket exceeds 4.
